**Subject: Re: SSO on the Team plan**

Hi [Name],

Thanks for asking. SSO isn't available today, including on the Team plan. We're building SAML SSO now and expect to ship it in Q1 2027. It will only be available on our Enterprise plan.

If SSO is a requirement for you, I'd be happy to set up a conversation about Enterprise. In the meantime, your Team plan works as usual with email and password sign-in.

Best,
[Your name]

---

This follows the 2026-10-20 decision in the decisions log: SSO is Enterprise-only and ships in Q1 2027, and we shouldn't promise it on Team. I worded the timing as "expect to ship" so it isn't a firm commitment. I also assumed Team uses email and password sign-in, which I didn't check. Delete that line if other sign-in methods exist.
